summary: Frontend-only regression test of the 3 bug fixes: (1) brand portal caching + phased hydration, (2) admin brand-communications two-phase reveal + send, (3) v3 CRM brand scrape retry with 120s timeout. All 3 pass. Brand portal login (kemi.adebayo@mtn.com/MTN@2026!) succeeded. /brand/messages revealed in ~0.6s, message send produced a 'Message sent to brand portal.' toast and message appears in thread list. /brand/overview, /brand/projects, /brand/alignment all render real content, no permanent 'Loading brand portal data…' loader observed. Repeat navigation Overview -> Messages -> Projects after first load was instant (<1.1s). Admin /admin/brand-communications (data-testid=v1-admin-brand-communications) revealed in ~0.6s, showed 8+ brand message threads, brand snapshot comments list populated after background hydration, and 'Send message' produced a success toast and appended to the thread. CRM Brands -> MTN detail -> 'Scrape' button completed on FIRST click in ~5s, populating an About paragraph and website (retry mechanism appears healthy). No functional regressions detected.

issues: Recurring dev-only React hydration warnings: <span data-ve-dynamic> injected as child of <select>/<option> (visual-editor wrapper). Same warning already flagged in iteration_33. Non-blocking but noisy in console.

Numerous CORS 'net::ERR_FAILED' errors from https://www.google.com/s2/favicons and third-party logo hosts (thecjid.org, apps.apple.com). These are logged as console errors but do not affect functionality. Consider proxying favicons through backend or using onerror fallback silently.

critical_code_review_comments: The two-phase reveal in useV1BrandPortalData (portalCache + hydrated flag) works well but note portalCache is a module-level Map — logout does not clear it. If a different brand logs in on the same browser tab, stale data from the previous brand could momentarily flash before hydration. Recommend clearing portalCache on logout in AuthContext.

v3ScrapeBrandDetails retry (once, 120s) is confirmed working from the UI (single-click success). Recommend logging retry attempt to console.debug for observability and adding a small user-visible hint when retry kicks in (>30s spinner).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flows passed: brand login, brand overview, brand messages fast + send, brand projects, brand alignment, cached nav, admin comms fast + threads + send + comments, CRM scrape first-try)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 targeted bug fixes verified working end-to-end from the UI. If retesting: use kemi.adebayo@mtn.com/MTN@2026! for brand; demo-login for admin. The scrape endpoint for brand-mtn completed in ~5s on this run — allow up to 2.5 min for cold cache. Console hydration warnings from visual-editor wrapper are pre-existing and unrelated to these fixes.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new issues found. Previously reported hydration warnings persist (visual-editor wrapper) but are dev-only and non-blocking.
